jobs.title: QA Engineer (Settlement & Reporting) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Stellenbeschreibung

We are looking for a

QA Engineer (m/f/d)

to join our team at our location in Berlin to build the next generation fintech.

Riverty’s partners and consumers rely on absolute precision when money changes hands. In Settlement and Reporting, financial integrity is not a late-stage audit: it is built directly into APIs, accounting workflows, reconciliation pipelines, and test evidence in Jira/Xray.

We are looking for someone who combines a tester’s rigorous domain judgment with an engineer’s delivery habits: you understand complex financial flows, you make ledger and reporting services testable, and you keep CI honest when tracking every cent.

What Will Be Your Challenge

As a QA Engineer, your role will involve developing software specifically for testing, such as tools, frameworks, and automated tests. You will work on enhancing the quality of existing applications by creating tests, conducting testing, and implementing test automation routines. Your daily tasks will include the following:

Planning testing automation for existing and upcoming projects (Unit Tests / Integration Tests including E2E / Performance Tests )
Support the team with quality tests.
Integrate automated tests into Azure Pipelines.
Brainstorm with the team on upcoming projects and keep test/quality in focus, mentoring team members with new testing technologies.
Proactively collaborate with the development team to ensure the code is testable and achieves comprehensive test coverage, helping the team to keep focus on test and quality.
Work closely with the product owner, giving an overview of the status and the upcoming project quality plan.

You Will Be Using Technologies

Languages: C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, SQL
API & workflow testing: NUnit, xUnit, Postman / Postman CLI, HTTP clients, Gherkin/Xray
BDD / shared test libraries: Reqnroll, Testing Commons, AI agents
Test infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Testcontainers,
CI/CD & Azure: Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure (Key Vault, storage, ACR), Git
Reporting & test management: Xray, ReportPortal, Jira, Confluence
Performance k6 and/or JMeter
Nice to have: Cypress, Kafka consumer testing

Qualifikationen

What Will Help You To Succeed In The Role

5+ years as SDET / QA Engineer / Quality Engineer, with automated tests in production CI
Solid knowledge of testing types and methods, and the judgment to choose unit vs integration vs functional vs E2E
Strong experience testing complex APIs and integrations (auth, persistence, downstream HTTP, messaging). Comfort reading YAML/JSON configs and tracing behaviour across services.
Proven delivery of automated suites and, ideally, shared test libraries or pipeline templates - not only one-off scripts.
CI/CD, source control, and dependency management as a normal part of the job. Experience in a DevOps-style team.
BDD/Gherkin experience is useful (Xray/Reqnroll). It is not the only style we use; most new service tests are NUnit/xUnit. Comfort with mixed unit/integration/functional/E2E across repos.
Curiosity about AI-assisted testing is a plus. Willingness to review, correct, and constrain generated tests is required.
As a person you are self-driven, proactive, and able to talk to both business and engineering stakeholders and fluent in English

Zusätzliche Informationen

Our Plus Points

Inclusive and valuing culture: At Riverty, you can be who you are. We strive to create an inclusive environment and an appreciative culture, enhanced by our employee networks.
Health & Wellbeing: Your physical and mental health is important to us. Take advantage of our various preventive care and support services.
Professional and Personal Development: Take advantage of our numerous training and development opportunities. Benefit, for example, from training courses offered by Bertelsmann University, language courses or leadership trainings.
Monetary Benefits & Discounts: Know that you're appreciated with plenty of employee benefits & discounts just for you.
Flexibility: Our diverse working models empower you to customize your work to perfectly align with your preferences. Benefit from mobile office, flexible working hours and part-time models.

More information on riverty.com/careers. Are you already convinced? Then we look forward to receiving your online application – with just a few clicks

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We want to be a fair and inclusive employer. We value the diverse perspectives that a diverse workforce brings to the table. Therefore, we are actively looking for people who enrich our company through their identity, background and personal experiences, with or without a disability.

jobs.title: Cloud & System Engineer
jobs.description:
itsme® has fundamentally changed how people lead their digital lives in Belgium
, but we are not stopping there! Do you want to be a driving force
to help expand on this success story as part of a talented team
that is making a positive impact
on society? Then keep on reading, you’ll probably like what you’ll see.

We are itsme®, one of Europe’s fastest-growing scale-ups
, with 150 team members and growing. Our mission: to provide a state-of-the-art digital identity solution for all people, enabling them to interact securely in the digital space. Now, only nine
years after being founded, close to 8 million citizens use the itsme® app
to identify
themselves and sign documents
online. Starting in Belgium, we successfully launched the itsme app in 32 European countries, with the ambition of becoming an internationally leading player
.

Itsme is looking for a Cloud & System Engineer
to join the team, to help implement new features while ensuring meticulous attention to detail and maintaining itsme's stability. The position is one with a focus on everything involving data. Backend databases of different flavours, with a focus on helping dev teams design and run performant systems, and setting up and maintaining a datalake platform, to enable our BI team to gain usefull insights. Maintaining operational efficiency and stability is paramount to the team's objectives. That's why monitoring systems and processes is crucial to address any issues directly. Collaboration with developers to implement new features is also an important aspect of the feature, ensuring that updates are seamlessly integrated into existing infrastructure. The successful candidate plays a crucial role in Itsme's national and international expansion and contributes to its continued growth and success within the digital identity sphere.

What your job looks like

Assist developers with database setups and structure to maintain the integrity, performance, and efficiency of the systems;
Troubleshoot database performance issues, and define both short and long term actions to fix structural issues
Setup and maintain a new data platform based on databricks
Automating deployment, scaling, and management of the containerized applications in a public cloud environment (e.g., setting up new infrastructure components with terraform and automated pipelines)
Implementation/configuration of security standards (e.g., NIST, OWASP);
Manage problems and (security) incidents (e.g. increased error rates in the itsme components, etc.):
Identifying the root causes of problems (i.e. root cause analysis at every level of the solution (application, network, infrastructure, storage)
Increase database/datalake knowledge in the team in general to make sure everybody in the team has the basic skills needed to troubleshoot database related incidents
Automate repetitive tasks that are performed manually.

Job requirements

You take ownership of your projects, reach out to your colleagues and can act as a go-to person;
You have an open and flexible mindset; You can easily adapt to changing contexts;
You have an automation mindset and are used to managing infrastructure as code.
You are a critical thinker and think about what the best solution is when you are asked to perform a task.
You are a team player who shares his/her knowledge and likes to celebrate joint achievements;
You are service- and customer-oriented;
You have strong SQL skills (query optimization, schema design, troubleshooting)
You have experience with MySQL administration specific on replication setups
You have a working knowledge of apache spark and pyspark for distributed data processing
Experience with azure synapse
Experience with databricks (workspace administration, cluster management, job orchestration)
Familiarity with noSQL DB’s like MongoDB
Knowledge of Redis or alternatives
Experience with Kubernetes based cloud environments (compute, networking, iam, storage)
Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code software (e.g. terraform)
Plus: Knowledge of scripting languages: python, golang, ...
Plus: experience with Grafana observability stack
Plus: experience with github actions pipelines
You are fluent in English, and in Dutch or French.

What we offer

Being welcomed by an informal, enthusiastic, and ambitious team that is revolutionising how we safely manage our digital identity, in Belgium & beyond.
Offices within walking distance from Brussels Central Station, with the possibility to work remotely 3 days a week.
A contract of indefinite duration, with an attractive compensation package.
An environment where we care a lot about our core values:
Impact:
Lead by example and create positive influence.
Resourcefulness:
Connect, mobilise, and collaborate across ecosystems.
Curiosity:
Explore, learn, and challenge the status quo.
Scale:
Build strong foundations for sustainable growth.
Humble:
Respect, listen, and embrace feedback for growth.

jobs.title: SDET
jobs.description:
Company Description
EgoTECHworld is a trusted partner for organizations and individuals seeking modern technology solutions and insights. The company provides cutting-edge IT services, opportunities to gain practical industry experience, and access to informative technology articles. EgoTECHworld focuses on helping clients leverage innovation to solve real-world challenges and remain competitive in a rapidly evolving tech landscape. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver high-quality results and continuously expand their technical expertise.
Role Description
The SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) role at EgoTECHworld is a full-time, remote position focused on building robust automated testing solutions for web and backend applications. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing, developing, and maintaining test automation frameworks, writing and executing automated test cases, and collaborating closely with developers and product teams to ensure software quality throughout the development lifecycle. The SDET will review technical specifications, identify test scenarios, perform code reviews related to testability, and help integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines. This role also involves monitoring test results, troubleshooting issues, and contributing to continuous improvement of testing practices and tools.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
Skills in Software Development and Programming, with experience writing clean, maintainable code in one or more modern languages (e.g., Java, C#, Python, JavaScript).
Proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and design patterns, applied to building test automation frameworks and reusable components.
Experience with Back-End Web Development, RESTful APIs, and related testing approaches (e.g., API testing, integration testing).
Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks (such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, or similar).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git), including integrating automated tests into build processes.
Understanding of software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, system, and regression testing.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and collaborate using online communication tools.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in Agile or Scrum environments and a strong focus on quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.
